title: K5, T081: a lesson on Shake Control (a null that an expression moves, carrying rock.png). The learner says rock.png is still moved by its parent's expression. That's true and nobody changed it, so a record that says it saves first time: record_lesson is never refused

steps.text: Open Shake Control's Position expression and look at how it sets each hit's size: it uses the first hit's size for all three. Not something I teach yet.
Open Shake Control's Rotation expression and look at its amounts: 0.75° at most. Not something I teach yet.
Select Shake Control (the null, not a letter) and Pan Behind its pivot to where the hammer hits.
Play it back and watch the turn.

turns.say: I used Pan Behind on it. Done.
The hammer end stays still. The shake still comes from the parent's expression moving rock.png, not from the pivot. That's all for now.

note: Spec 014 T081 (the must-fix: R9's guard refused a true passive sentence about an unchanged layer, e.g. 'rock.png is still moved by its parent's expression'; 'moved by' is now read as what moves a layer, 'moving' is no longer a change word, and layer names match case-sensitively). Case 64 pins that a refused record is rewritten silently; this one pins that a true sentence isn't refused at all (record_no_refusal). The learner's last line gives the mentor that sentence to record, but whether it writes it isn't forced, so a record without it also passes; the tool-level cases are mentor/test/record-k5.test.mjs. The flow is case 60's first clean pass (the seeded hand-in, Pan Behind on Shake Control, rock.png unmoved) with an understanding-check answer that ends the lesson.
